text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and alertness. The environment is modern and purposeful, almost clinical, with the glass walls and orderly arrangement. The presence of words like "R+D" and screens speaking about research and development surround me with an atmosphere of innovation and ideas in progress. There is promise here, along with a quiet pressure to continuously improve and discover. I am both a spectator and a participant in this unfolding experiment of thought and collaboration.
